description: Pendulum starting nearly vertical (initial_theta=1.4 radians), showing large-amplitude non-linear swing behavior.
code:
from manim import *
from manim_physics import *

class PendulumNearVertical(SpaceScene):
    def construct(self):
        p = Pendulum(
            length=2.5,
            initial_theta=1.4,
            pivot_point=UP * 2,
        )
        self.add(p)
        self.make_rigid_body(*p.bobs)
        p.start_swinging()
        self.wait(2)
